Decision: Build the prototype as a browser-only web app with no server
Reason: Fits the timeline and lets testers use it on any phone; the full API will be specified separately
Alternatives considered: Firebase back end; Kotlin Android app

Decision: SMS confirmation is specified but simulated in the prototype
Reason: No SMS gateway access for a study project

Decision: Status reports issued on Saturdays (24 Oct and 31 Oct) instead of Fridays
Reason: The baseline plan listed 'Friday 24 Oct' but 24 Oct 2026 is a Saturday; baseline left unchanged and corrected here

Decision: Pain point IDs are never reused; new findings get new IDs (P8-P10)
Reason: Keeps traceability from requirements back to sources

Decision: Requirements not raised in interviews (documents; reports) lowered from Must to Should
Reason: Priority follows evidence; they stay in scope as assumptions to confirm with staff

Decision: Delegated signing authority recorded as a process recommendation; not built into the system
Reason: Who may sign is a legal and municipal decision; software can only support it
